name: s3-episode-runtime
title: S3 Verified Episode Runtime
description: Run admitted TaskPacks with target policies, preserve complete public trajectories, execute frozen verification, and publish deterministic Reward/abstention Episode artifacts for S4
scope: Implement one reusable public-policy episode runtime and immutable Episode artifacts over exact EnvironmentRelease v2 and S2 TaskPacks; allow narrowly required refactors of S2 execution code, but do not generate Tasks or train models
creator: kelong
notes: Candidate plan only; no implementation authority until the revised artifacts receive explicit user approval and task.py start runs. Exact Git, SQLite and inherited-maintenance Release/Corpus/TaskPack authority passed current production cold readers on 2026-08-31; Git regeneration provenance is recorded in research/input-readiness.md. S3 must reuse exact S2 Task truth and the existing close/reopen lifecycle. It may refactor shared execution primitives where failed policy trajectories or S4 policy driving cannot otherwise be represented, but may not add a second Agent loop, Task generator, verifier authority, automatic retry scheduler, service layer, Registry, optimizer or training format.
